feeds.title: Living Life and Learning
feeds.description: I'm a homeschooling mother to 3 kids who are 9, 13, and 19. I've been homeschooling for 13 years and through all of these years have kept science fun and relaxed while allowing the kids to choose what they study for science. Science is now a time my kids look forward to, no more complaints, they remember what is taught and more importantly, they're having fun even when experiments don't work.

feeds.title: OFTP Blog
feeds.description: The Ontario Federation of Teaching Parents (OFTP) is a provincial homeschooling support and advocacy group. A non-profit association run by volunteer members, OFTP provides information about home learning, enables networking among its members, and serves as an advocacy group and link between the homeschooling community and the provincial government. We are open to all, inclusive of all languages, all faiths/philosophies, and all educational styles.

feeds.title: Homeschooling in Nova Scotia
feeds.description: Welcome to Homeschooling in Nova Scotia! I am Kimberly Charron, a homeschooling mother of two living with my husband of over 25 years in Halifax, Nova Scotia. I have been serving the homeschooling community by providing homeschool information and support through Homeschooling in Nova Scotia since 2008. I am also an Online Business Manager, Social Media Manager, writer, editor, and tech services provider.

feeds.title: Daily Wonder Home Learning Blog
feeds.description: Explore schedules, rhythms & routines, songs, music, festivals, free play, meals, projects & more to support your homeschooling program. Daily Wonder supports parents to provide integrated, culturally diverse, creative, hands-on Waldorf curriculum for their homeschoolers that aligns with grade-level learning standards.

feeds.title: CCHE Blog
feeds.description: CCHE has taken steps towards greater homeschooling advocacy. Through digital marketing, print, radio, and television coverage, we're taking a proactive approach by influencing the public and government's views of homeschooling. We see research as an effective legal tool. That's why we gather the most accurate data to assist us in all our efforts.

feeds.title: Practical, By Default » Homeschooling
feeds.description: Explore the blog for articles on homeschooling. I am Jennifer. I help working moms balance their careers and homeschool their kids by providing practical solutions and a side order of coffee.

feeds.title: Learning Mama
feeds.description: I'm Alison, and I'm Learning Mama! I'm a Canadian homeschooling mama to three sweet girls. I view homeschooling through the lens of discipleship, and education as a lifelong endeavor, and am thankful that I can begin each day anew by the grace of God. I've been homeschooling now for over a decade, and I'm nearing the end of the journey now with my oldest - what a ride!

feeds.title: My Cup Runs Over » Homeschooling
feeds.description: Read articles on homeschooling. Welcome to My Cup Runs Over, where I help overly busy women slow down, discover their passion and purpose, create balance, accomplish their goals, and intentionally pursue the most meaningful lives they can dream up.

feeds.title: Passionate Homeschooling Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kim, a homeschool mom of 6 who believes that learning should be fun for kids and moms! My goal is to help you make learning engaging and enjoyable with hands-on learning and easy-to-do lessons that actually get done.

feeds.title: The Canadian Homeschooler
feeds.description: Hi, there I'm Lisa Marie a busy homeschooling mom of 5 kids ranging from preschool to high school. My mission is to help Canadian homeschooling families connect and also with companies and resources that will help them on their learning journey from start to finish. I want them to be able to find curriculum, materials, and resources that are relevant to them, their experiences, and their history.
